notes.title: The Space Update
notes.notes:
[h3]New Update Alert![/h3]

Get ready to shop among the stars with our latest update! 

We’re thrilled to introduce [b]The Space[/b], a brand new theme where you'll compete in zero gravity, avoid space-themed hazards, and check-off the new out-of-this-world items on your shopping list!  

And that's not all! We've also added a new game mode: [b]Sequential Mode[/b], where you won’t know the next item on your list until you’ve handed in the current one. 

Suit up with the newest player skin: [b]The Chief[/b], become a space soldier ready for action and show the universe who's boss when it comes to shopping!

Happy shopping!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] General:
[list]
[*] Added new theme: The Space
[*] Added 5 space theme layouts
[*] Added new player skin: Chief
[*] Added Sequential game mode
[*] Reduced the number of objects per category from 6 to 4
[*] Increased the minimum stock for each item from 2 to 3
[*] Removed honey trap from modern layouts
[*] Changed colour of modern shelves to make the objects stand out
[*] Now when objects are placed on the shelves they are rotated to make them match their sticker
[*] Deal items now shine all the time
[*] Tournament Theme layout randomization changed to show at least a layout of each theme before repeating
[*] Items pushed by players now return to their shelf positions after some time
[*] Increased the 'return to shelf' time for objects left on the ground by players
[*] Now items return to their shelf even when players are nearby
[*] Changed hold 'Y' to start the game to - hold 'A'
[/list]
[*] Tiebreakers:
[list]
[*] Reduced tiebreaker list length from 2 items to 1 item
[*] Now all players have the same item to turn in
[*] Instead of just one counter being open, now all counters can open an close as if it was a regular match
[*] Pandemic mode tiebreaker is now down to a single roll of paper
[*] Pandemic mode tiebreaker roll of paper shines
[/list]
[*] Tutorial:
[list]
[*] Added delivery area and deal stand showcase stickers
[*] Removed most of the texts
[*] Highlighted player lists at the beginning
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the deal item would not spawn in tutorial
[*] Pandemic mode now takes into account list item amount modifier
[*] Removed some inaccseible memory powerup spawn points from modern layouts
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] General:
[list]
[*] Created a language selection panel for new players the first time game is opened.
[*] Now there is a playable tutorial.
[*] The location of the delivery areas and deal stands is highlighted before the match starts
[*] Balanced the timing of supermarket events such as steam vents and delivery area shutdowns
[/list]
[*] Delivery areas:
[list]
[*]  Now players can turn in items while other item is being processed.
[*] The item will be added to a queue and turned in as soon as possible. The queue can hold up to 3 items.
[*] Delivery areas now display the icon of the items being processed with the color of the player that turned them in.
[*] Now it should be easier to turn in items, either manually of by throwing them.
[/list]
[*]Deal stands:
[list]
[*] Deals now count as one random item from your shopping list instead of two.
[*] Now players are warned when a deal is about to spawn.
[*] If a deal is not picked up from the stand it will disappear after some time.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed some inaccessible powerup spawn locations.
[*] Adjusted the volume of some sounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - 0.2.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] General:
[list]
[*] Modified dungeon items so they are more easily recognizable
[*] Items will return to their shelves after being left on the ground for some time
[*] Adjusted randomization algorithm so it is less likely that a game mode will repeat back to back
[*] NPCs are now slightly easier to push
[*] Adjusted several dungeon colliders
[/list]
[*] Memory mode:
[list]
[*] Now players can see their remaining items at the end of the match
[*] Shopping lists will be displayed again when tiebreaker starts
[*] Enhanced powerup visibility and spawn rate
[/list]
[*]Pandemic mode:
[list]
[*] Improved toilet paper visibility on dungeon theme
[*] Improved toilet paper shopping list UI
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer get stuck behind cashiers
[*] Items will no longer get stuck on top of modern fridges
[*] Game no longer freezes when checking out the last toilet paper in pandemic mode results in a tie
[*] List powerup now only shows the list of the first player that collects it
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
...aaaand we also had a little bit of an identity crisis so we are changing the name of our studio. Say goodbye to Throwback Thursday, now we are... BUCKET FORGE. Hope you like the new name and logo.

Happy shopping!

notes.title: Added Chinese localization!
notes.notes:
Attention, shoppers!

Checkout! is now available in Chinese!

To our Chinese-speaking players, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you for your unwavering support!

So, grab your lists and get ready to shop your way to victory! Your support has made this possible, and we're thrilled to bring Checkout! to you in your native language.

As we continue to add more content to the game, we hope you'll keep accompanying us on this journey!

notes.title: Patch notes - 0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW PANDEMIC GAME MODE:[/h1]
We all know what happened on supermarkets around the world with the recent pandemic, so on the new [i]Pandemic[/i] game mode your aim is to, you guessed it, hoard toilet paper!


[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced item visibility both in game and in the players' shopping lists
[*] Added Pandemic game mode
[*] Added a new skin
[*] Added 1 new dungeon layout
[*] Added 2 new modern layouts
[*] Added Simplified Chinese language option
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello shoppers! We're excited to share our plan for the future of [i]Checkout! [/i]

From new game modes and themes to gameplay improvements, we're committed to making your experience more fun and complete. 

A big thank you to our players in Chinese-speaking countries - we've heard you and prioritized Chinese localization!

Your feedback is invaluable, we look through every piece so if you have any thoughts or want to discuss any aspect of the game, let us know in the discussions, or you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/w4D3TSSUBG]discord [/url]:)
